name: v0.3.10 — Detail screens preserve dashboard data scope + navigation audit tests
releaseNotes:
• GuacScore + GuacWizard + Receipt-detail screens now call loadReceipts(period: ReceiptPeriod.all) instead of the default 1-month — visiting them no longer shrinks the dashboard's full-history cache, so the dashboard's tile values don't drift after going back.
• New automated tests (mobile/test/navigation_back_button_audit_test.dart) — verifies every screen has Scaffold+AppBar (so ← back arrow renders), main.dart wires CupertinoPageTransitionsBuilder for every platform (so left-edge swipe-back works everywhere), and the dashboard never falls back to context.go() (which would break the back stack).
• Full Dart test suite (13 tests including the 9 cross-platform score fixtures) green.
